name: Slippery
description: Ice everywhere. Slow to start and stop.
_help: Grip is how fast you reach the speed you're pushing for, per second (higher = less slippery). Platformer: groundGrip on the ground, airGrip in the air. Shmup: shipGrip while you're steering, shipStop when you let go (low = you keep sliding). Racer: grip multiplies how fast you speed up and brake (low = wheels spin and you skid toward the edge). Brawler: groundGrip/airGrip like the platformer, enemyGrip for enemies walking, knockbackGrip for how fast a punched enemy stops sliding (normal is 8; low = they slide off ledges).
